jobs.title: Internship in Power Converter Engineering 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity We are looking for a motivated intern to join our Power Conversion Engineering team and support Engineering Management in strengthening and governing our engineering processes. How you'll make an impact Support the definition and improvement of engineering processes and workflows Help maintain process documentation, guidelines, and templates Support process governance and continuous improvement activities Coordinate inputs and follow up actions across engineering teams Contribute to digitalization and standardization initiatives Your background Student in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field Structured, analytical, and proactive working style Interest in engineering processes and technology Good communication skills and proficiency in English More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità Stiamo cercando uno stagista motivato per unire il nostro team di Power Conversion Engineering e supportare Engineering Management nel rafforzare e governare i nostri processi ingegneristici. Supporto per la definizione e il miglioramento dei processi di ingegneria e dei flussi di lavoro Aiuta a mantenere la documentazione di processo, le linee guida e i modelli Sostenere la governance dei processi e le attività di miglioramento continuo Coordinare gli input e seguire le azioni tra i team di ingegneria Contribuire alle iniziative di digitalizzazione e standardizzazione Il vostro background Student in Ingegneria, Ingegneria Industriale, o un campo correlato Strutturato, analitico, e stile di lavoro proattivo Interessi nei processi di ingegneria e tecnologia Buone capacità di comunicazione e competenza in inglese Siamo una società tecnologica-driven con un forte focus sull'innovazione, il miglioramento continuo e la produzione sostenibile.
• Offriamo condizioni di lavoro flessibili, mentorship dedicato, e un ambiente di supporto e inclusivo in cui si può crescere personalmente e professionalmente - consentendo di prosperare mentre bilanciare la vita e il lavoro.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Chance Wir suchen einen motivierten Praktikanten, der sich unserem Power Conversion Engineering Team anschließt und das Engineering Management bei der Stärkung und Steuerung unserer Engineering-Prozesse unterstützt. Wie Sie Einfluss nehmen Unterstützung bei der Definition und Verbesserung von Engineering-Prozessen und Workflows Hilfe bei der Pflege von Prozessdokumentation, Richtlinien und Vorlagen Unterstützung von Prozess-Governance- und kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsaktivitäten Koordinierung von Inputs und Folgemaßnahmen in allen Engineering-Teams Beitrag zu Digitalisierungs- und Standardisierungsinitiativen Ihr Hintergrund Student in Engineering, Industrial Engineering oder einem verwandten Bereich Strukturierte, analytische und proaktive Arbeitsstil Interesse an Ingenieurprozessen und Technologie Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und Englischkenntnisse Mehr über uns Wir sind ein technologiegetriebenes Unternehmen mit einem starken Fokus auf Innovation, kontinuierliche Verbesserung und nachhaltige Fertigung.
• Wir bieten flexible Arbeitsbedingungen, engagierte Mentorenschaft und ein unterstützendes, integratives Umfeld, in dem Sie persönlich und beruflich wachsen können - und ermöglichen Ihnen, zu gedeihen und gleichzeitig Leben und Arbeit in Einklang zu bringen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:

jobs.title: Junior Produktionsplaner 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position Für unseren Standort in Zürich Oerlikon suchen wir einen Junior Produktionsplaner (m\/w\/d) für unseren Bereich Generatorschalter. In dieser Schlüsselfunktion stellst du die effiziente Planung und Steuerung unserer Fertigungsaufträge sicher und fungierst als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Produktion, Projektmanagement und den unterstützenden Fachbereichen. So leistest du einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung unserer Kundenaufträge. Das kannst du bewirken Planung, Steuerung und Überwachung der Produktionsprozesse unter Berücksichtigung von Kapazitäten, Materialverfügbarkeiten und Terminvorgaben Zentrale Koordinations- und Schnittstellenfunktion zwischen Produktion, Einkauf, Logistik, Qualitätssicherung, Engineering und Projektmanagement Verantwortung für die Terminierung und Steuerung von Fertigungsaufträgen sowie die Sicherstellung eines effizienten Material- und Produktionsflusses Erstellung und Pflege von Produktionsunterlagen, Arbeitsplänen, Fertigungsdokumentationen sowie Unterstützung bei der Arbeitsvorbereitung Überprüfung von Vorgabezeiten, Pflege relevanter Material- und Stammdaten sowie Unterstützung bei der Weiterentwicklung von Arbeitsplätzen und Prozessen Analyse von Produktionskennzahlen sowie Erstellung von Berichten und Auswertungen zur Sicherstellung von Transparenz und Leistung Aktive Mitarbeit bei der Optimierung von Prozessen, Abläufen und Systemen zur Steigerung von Effizienz, Qualität und Produktivität Dein Hintergrund Abgeschlossene technische oder kaufmännische Ausbildung, idealerweise mit Weiterbildung zum\/zur Prozessfachmann\/-frau Routine im Umgang mit ERP-Systemen (SAP) und MS Office Organisationstalent, Kommunikationsstärke und eine lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise Interesse an Produktionsprozessen sowie Freude an der Analyse und Optimierung von Arbeitsabläufen Deine Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sind fließend in Wort und Schrift Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen dir, deine persönlichen und beruflichen Leistungen zu optimieren, und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können --- English translation --- Junior Production Planner 80 - 100% (f\/m\/d) The opportunity For our site in Zurich Oerlikon, we are looking for a Junior Production Planner (m\/f\/d) for our Generator Circuit Breaker division. In this key role, you will ensure the efficient planning and control of our production orders and serve as the central interface between production, project management, and supporting departments. In doing so, you will make a significant contribution to the successful and timely execution of our customer projects. How you'll make an impact Planning, coordinating, and monitoring production processes while considering capacity, material availability, and delivery schedules Serving as the central coordination and interface function between Production, Procurement, Logistics, Quality, Engineering, and Project Management Taking responsibility for scheduling and controlling manufacturing orders and ensuring an efficient flow of materials and production activities Creating and maintaining production documents, work plans and routings, as well as supporting production preparation activities Reviewing standard times, maintaining relevant material and master data, and supporting the further development of workplaces and processes Analyzing production KPIs and preparing reports and evaluations to ensure transparency and performance Actively contributing to the optimization of processes, workflows, and systems to increase efficiency, quality, and productivity Your background Completed technical or commercial vocational training, ideally complemented by further education as a Process Specialist Experience working with ERP systems (SAP) and Microsoft Office Strong organizational and communication skills, with a solution-oriented approach to work Interest in production processes and enthusiasm for analyzing and optimizi

In questo ruolo chiave, garantirai la pianificazione e il controllo efficiente dei nostri ordini di produzione e servirai come interfaccia centrale tra la produzione, la gestione del progetto e i dipartimenti di supporto. In questo modo, fornirete un contributo significativo alla riuscita e tempestiva esecuzione dei nostri progetti clienti. Dans dieser Schlüselfunktion stellst du die effiziente Planung und Steuerung unserer Fertigungsaufträge sicher und fongerst als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Produktion, Projektmanagement und den unterstützenden Fachbereichen. Donc leistest du einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung unserer Kundenaufträge. Il s'agit d'un système d'information et de communication qui permet d'obtenir des informations et des informations sur les activités de l'entreprise. L'opportunité Pour notre site à Zurich Oerlikon, nous recherchons un planificateur de production junior (m\/f\/d) pour notre division de disjoncteur. Dans ce rôle clé, vous assurerez la planification et le contrôle efficaces de nos commandes de production et servirez d'interface centrale entre la production, la gestion de projet et les services d'appui. Ce faisant, vous apporterez une contribution importante à l'exécution réussie et opportune de nos projets clients. Comment vous ferez un impact Planification, coordination et suivi des processus de production tout en tenant compte de la capacité, de la disponibilité du matériel et des calendriers de livraison Servir de fonction centrale de coordination et d'interface entre la production, l'approvisionnement, la logistique, la qualité, l'ingénierie et la gestion de projet Prendre en charge l'établissement et le contrôle des commandes de fabrication et assurer un flux efficace de matériaux et d'activités de production Créer et maintenir des documents de production, des plans de travail et des routages, ainsi que soutenir les activités de préparation de la production Examiner les heures normales, maintenir le matériel pertinent et les données de base, et appuyer le développement des lieux de travail et des processus Analyser les ICR de production et préparer des rapports et des évaluations afin d'assurer la transparence et la performance Contribuer activement à l'optimisation des processus, des flux de travail et des systèmes afin d'accroître l'efficacité, la qualité et la productivité.

jobs.title: Real Estate Controller 80 – 100% (f/m/d) --- 12-month contract
jobs.description: The opportunity At Hitachi Energy, we are looking for an experienced Real Estate Controller, for a 12-month temporary assignment, to drive financial excellence across our global real estate portfolio. In this strategic role, you will oversee financial reporting, portfolio performance, compliance, and investment analysis while partnering with stakeholders across multiple functions and regions. How you'll make an impact Oversee accounting, financial reporting, and performance analysis for Hitachi's global real estate portfolio, including investment and corporate properties Prepare and manage budgets, forecasts, cash flow analyses, and financial plans to support business objectives Develop, implement, and continuously improve internal controls, financial policies, and governance frameworks related to real estate activities Conduct financial due diligence and provide commercial assessments for acquisitions, disposals, leasing transactions, and strategic investments Monitor portfolio performance against financial targets, KPIs, and market benchmarks, identifying opportunities for improvement Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards (IFRS\/GAAP), tax regulations, and real estate-related legal requirements Partner with internal functions such as Legal, Tax, Treasury, and Facilities Management, as well as external auditors, appraisers, and property managers Deliver strategic financial insights and recommendations to senior leadership while driving process optimization and digitalization initiatives Your background Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; a Master's degree or professional certification (CPA, ACCA, CMA) is an advantage Minimum 8 years of experience in financial controlling, real estate finance, or real estate accounting within an international environment Strong knowledge of real estate accounting principles, including lease accounting under IFRS 16 and\/or ASC 842 Experience in financial modeling, investment analysis, valuation methodologies, and business case development Solid understanding of tax implications and regulatory requirements relating to real estate transactions and operations Proficiency with ERP systems such as SAP and advanced Excel skills; experience with reporting and BI tools is a plus Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain complex financial matters to non-financial audiences Proactive, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a dynamic, fast-paced environment More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Industrial Engineer for GIS Production 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity We are seeking a highly motivated Industrial Engineer with a focus on Automation and Robotics to optimize and improve the efficiency of our Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) production lines. This role involves applying industrial engineering principles as well as automation technologies and robotic solutions to enhance manufacturing processes, reduce waste, and improve productivity. Motivated graduates with a strong focus on automation and robotics are also encouraged to apply. How you'll make an impact Analyse current GIS production line layouts, workflows, and operational procedures to identify areas for improvement in efficiency, cost, and quality, with a focus on automation potential Design and implement optimized production processes, including new methodologies, automation concepts, robotic applications, equipment utilization, and material flow Conduct time and motion studies, process mapping, and value stream analysis to identify bottlenecks and eliminate non-value-added activities. Develop and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) and work instructions for GIS assembly and testing, including automated and robot-assisted processes Collaborate with other industrial engineers, production managers, design engineers, quality and new product implementation team Lead and participate in continuous improvement initiatives, including Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma projects, leveraging digitalization and automation technologies Evaluate, specify, and implement new technologies, including robotics (e.g., cobots), automated systems, and smart manufacturing solutions for the GIS production environment Your background Master's degree in Automation Engineering, Robotics, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field Initial professional experience in industrial engineering within a manufacturing environment is preferred Initial or proven experience with industrial automation and\/or robotics integration (e.g., robotic cells, cobots, automated material handling systems) Strong background in process optimization, lean manufacturing principles, and continuous improvement methodologies (e.g., Kaizen, Six Sigma) Proficiency in process analysis tools (e.g., value stream mapping, time studies, statistical process control) Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously Familiarity with GIS production processes or similar complex electrical equipment manufacturing is highly desirable Business fluent in English and German More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Internship in Foundation Models and Optimization for Power Grids 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity The System and Automation team at the Swiss research center is looking for an intern student with expertise in numerical optimization and machine learning (ML) to contribute to cutting-edge developments for modern power grid operation. The internship will focus on applying ML techniques to accelerate and improve numerical algorithms for real-time power system monitoring, enabling more reliable, efficient, and resilient grid operation. You will work in a dynamic and multidisciplinary research environment and will be supervised by experienced researchers in power systems, optimization, and artificial intelligence. If you have a strong technical background, motivation to develop innovative solutions, and are goal-oriented, this is your opportunity to contribute to a stronger and more sustainable energy future. The duration of the internship is six months. How you'll make an impact Contribute to research activities on ML-based methods for power system monitoring Investigate, deploy and refine foundation models for representing power grid topology, measurements, and operating conditions Combine ML-driven methods with numerical optimization and power system physics Evaluate the proposed methods through simulation studies and benchmarking Report and disseminate results within the team, write technical documentation, and contribute creative ideas towards industrial implementation Your background Enrolled in an MSc program in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, or a related field Strong background in numerical optimization. Power system knowledge is a plus Good knowledge of machine learning and deep learning. Exposure to graph neural networks, foundation model or machine learning adaptation strategies is a plus Experience in Python or C++ programming and MATLAB Experience with PyTorch or similar deep learning frameworks Excellent communication skills, team player attitude, initiative, and creativity Fluency in English, written and spoken More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

jobs.title: Factory Planning & Fulfillment Manager
jobs.description: The opportunity Join us as a Planning & Fulfillment Manager and become a key driver of our operational success . In this highly visible leadership role, you will oversee and continuously enhance our end-to-end planning and fulfillment activities, translating customer demand into efficient and profitable execution. By connecting strategy with operations, you will lead planning processes, foster collaboration across the value chain, and ensure the optimal balance of service, inventory, capacity, and cost. Your expertise will help strengthen operational resilience, accelerate transformation initiatives, and support the achievement of our business and customer commitments. How you'll make an impact Own and lead the factory Planning processes, starting from long-term Demand Planning, Sales Engineering & Operations Planning (SE&OP), Capacity Planning, Master Production Planning, Detailed Scheduling, Material Planning, and Sales & Operations Execution (S&OE) processes. Leading the local SE&OP process and aligning with Product Line Planning team, assess the factory's ability to support the long-term demand plan and ensure alignment between customer requirements, production capacity, material availability, inventory strategy, and financial objectives. Translate demand forecasts, customer orders, and project requirements into feasible supply, production, material, and delivery plans and constantly monitor forecast accuracy and backlog development. Managing short-, medium-, and long-term production and coordinating production and supply priorities and capacity, optimize the utilization of installed and manned capacity while maintaining operational flexibility and reliable customer delivery. Establish, monitor, and continuously improve the principal Planning & Fulfillment performance indicators (Customer On-Time Delivery, Schedule Adherence (Internal OTD), Delivery Total ThroughPut Time and TPT, Forecast Accuracy, Material Availability, Capacity Utilization, Inventory Turns, Supplier Delivery Performance) to provide real-time visibility of factory performance. Drive the deployment, adoption, and optimization of ERP (SAP 4\/Hana), Advanced Planning and Scheduling, analytics, and digital supply chain solutions. Lead continuous improvement and operational excellence initiatives across planning, procurement, inventory, fulfillment, logistics processes. Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing Planning & Fulfillment organization, including planning, material management, operative purchasing, fulfillment, and logistics professionals. Your background Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management or a related field. Master's Degree (MBA or Supply Chain specialization) preferred. Minimum 8-10 years of progressive experience in Supply Chain, Planning, Fulfillment, Production Planning, Logistics, or Operations Management. Minimum of 5 years of people leadership experience in Sales Engineering & Operations planning (preferably in an ETO business). Proficiency in ERP systems and supply chain management software; knowledge of Advanced Planning Tools (like Drummer or Cyberplan is a plus). Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven approach to decision-making (Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma certification is a plus). Strong communication skills with the ability to convey information effectively. Italian is Mandatory; Fluent in English. Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor teams, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and learning. Experience in transformers or electrical equipment is a plus but not mandatory. More about us: Hitachi Energy is dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where every team member can thrive and contribute their unique perspectives and skills. We provide competitive salaries, flexible working hours, professional development opportunities, and a supportive work environment that encourages growth and innovation through career development prog

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire de la planification et de l'exécution de l'usine

descriptionByLocale.it: Unisciti a noi come responsabile di pianificazione e adempimento e diventare un driver chiave del nostro successo operativo. In questo ruolo di leadership altamente visibile, supervisionerete e migliorare continuamente le nostre attività di pianificazione e realizzazione end-to-end, traducendo la domanda del cliente in un'esecuzione efficiente e redditizia. Collegando la strategia con le operazioni, guiderai i processi di pianificazione, promuoverai la collaborazione tra la catena del valore e garantirai l'equilibrio ottimale del servizio, dell'inventario, della capacità e dei costi. La vostra esperienza contribuirà a rafforzare la resilienza operativa, accelerare le iniziative di trasformazione, e sostenere il raggiungimento dei nostri impegni commerciali e clienti. Come farete un impatto proprio e guidare i processi di pianificazione della fabbrica, a partire da processi di pianificazione della domanda a lungo termine, ingegneria delle vendite e pianificazione delle operazioni (SE&OP), pianificazione delle capacità, pianificazione della produzione di master, pianificazione dettagliata, pianificazione dei materiali e processi di esecuzione delle vendite e delle operazioni (S&OE). Leader del processo locale SE&OP e allineare con il team di Product Line Planning, valutare la capacità della fabbrica di sostenere il piano di domanda a lungo termine e garantire l'allineamento tra i requisiti del cliente, capacità di produzione, disponibilità dei materiali, strategia di inventario e obiettivi finanziari. Traduci le previsioni della domanda, gli ordini del cliente e i requisiti del progetto in termini di fornitura, produzione, materiale e piani di consegna fattibile e monitora costantemente l'accuratezza delle previsioni e lo sviluppo del backlog. Gestire la produzione a breve, medio e lungo termine e coordinare le priorità di produzione e di fornitura e la capacità, ottimizzare l'utilizzo della capacità installata e maneggiata mantenendo al contempo la flessibilità operativa e la fornitura affidabile del cliente. Stabilire, monitorare e migliorare continuamente i principali indicatori di performance di pianificazione e adempimento (Customer On-Time Delivery, Schedule Adherence (Internal OTD), Delivery Total ThroughPut Time and TPT, Forecast Accuracy, Material Availability, Capacity Usezation, Inventory Turns, Fornitore Delivery Performance) per fornire visibilità in tempo reale delle prestazioni di fabbrica. Guidare la distribuzione, l'adozione e l'ottimizzazione di ERP (SAP 4\/Hana), Advanced Planning and Scheduling, analisi e soluzioni di supply chain digitali. Condurre iniziative di miglioramento continuo e di eccellenza operativa attraverso la pianificazione, l'approvvigionamento, l'inventario, la realizzazione, i processi logistici. Lead, coach e sviluppare un'organizzazione di pianificazione e adempimento altamente performante, tra cui pianificazione, gestione dei materiali, acquisto operativo, adempimento e professionisti della logistica. La tua laurea in Ingegneria, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Gestione Operazioni o un campo relativo. Master's Degree (MBA o specializzazione Supply Chain) preferito. Minimo 8-10 anni di esperienza progressiva nella Supply Chain, pianificazione, adempimento, pianificazione della produzione, logistica o gestione delle operazioni. Minimo 5 anni di esperienza di leadership nella pianificazione di Sales Engineering & Operations (preferibilmente in un'impresa ETO). La competenza nei sistemi ERP e nel software di gestione della supply chain; la conoscenza degli strumenti di pianificazione avanzata (come Drummer o Cyberplan è un plus). Eccellente analitica e problem solving competenze, con un approccio data-driven al processo decisionale (Lean Manufacturing o Six Sigma certificazione è un plus). Forte capacità di comunicazione con la capacità di trasmettere informazioni in modo efficace. L'italiano è obbligatorio; fluente in inglese. Dimostrata capacità di guidare e team di mentore, promuovendo una cultura di miglioramento continuo e apprendimento. L'esperienza in trasformatori o apparecchiature elettriche è un plus ma non obbligatorio. Maggiori informazioni su di noi: Hitachi Energy è dedicata a promuovere un posto di lavoro inclusivo dove ogni membro del team può prosperare e contribuire alle loro prospettive e competenze uniche. Forniamo salari competitivi, orari di lavoro flessibili, opportunità di sviluppo professionale, e un ambiente di lavoro di supporto che incoraggia la crescita e l'innovazione attraverso lo sviluppo della carriera

descriptionByLocale.de:
Begleiten Sie uns als Planning & Fulfillment Manager und werden Sie ein wichtiger Treiber unseres operativen Erfolgs. In dieser sehr sichtbaren Führungsrolle werden Sie unsere End-to-End-Planungs- und Fulfillment-Aktivitäten überwachen und kontinuierlich verbessern und die Kundennachfrage in eine effiziente und profitable Ausführung umwandeln. Durch die Verbindung von Strategie und Betrieb leiten Sie die Planungsprozesse, fördern die Zusammenarbeit entlang der Wertschöpfungskette und gewährleisten die optimale Balance zwischen Service, Lagerbestand, Kapazität und Kosten. Ihre Expertise wird dazu beitragen, die operative Widerstandsfähigkeit zu stärken, Transformationsinitiativen zu beschleunigen und die Erfüllung unserer Geschäfts- und Kundenverpflichtungen zu unterstützen. Eigene und leitende Fabrikplanungsprozesse, beginnend mit langfristigen Demand Planning, Sales Engineering & Operations Planning (SE&OP), Capacity Planning, Master Production Planning, Detailed Scheduling, Material Planning und Sales & Operations Execution (S&OE) Prozessen. Führen Sie den lokalen SE & OP-Prozess und stimmen Sie sich mit dem Product Line Planning-Team ab, bewerten Sie die Fähigkeit der Fabrik, den langfristigen Bedarfsplan zu unterstützen und sicherzustellen, dass die Kundenanforderungen, die Produktionskapazität, die Materialverfügbarkeit, die Lagerstrategie und die finanziellen Ziele aufeinander abgestimmt werden. Übersetzen Sie Bedarfsprognosen, Kundenaufträge und Projektanforderungen in machbare Liefer-, Produktions-, Material- und Lieferpläne und überwachen Sie die Prognosegenauigkeit und die Auftragsbestandsentwicklung ständig. Verwaltung der kurz-, mittel- und langfristigen Produktion und Koordinierung der Produktions- und Lieferprioritäten und -kapazitäten, Optimierung der Auslastung der installierten und bemannten Kapazitäten bei gleichzeitiger Aufrechterhaltung der betrieblichen Flexibilität und zuverlässigen Kundenlieferung. Etablieren, überwachen und kontinuierlich verbessern Sie die wichtigsten Planungs- & Fulfillment-Performance-Indikatoren (Customer On-Time Delivery, Schedule Adherence (Internal OTD), Delivery Total ThroughPut Time und TPT, Forecast Accuracy, Material Availability, Capacity Utilization, Inventory Turns, Supplier Delivery Performance), um Echtzeit-Sichtbarkeit der Fabrikleistung zu bieten. Führen Sie die Bereitstellung, Einführung und Optimierung von ERP (SAP 4\/Hana), Advanced Planning and Scheduling, Analytics und digitalen Supply Chain-Lösungen voran. Führen Sie kontinuierliche Verbesserungs- und operative Exzellenzinitiativen für Planungs-, Beschaffungs-, Inventar-, Fulfillment- und Logistikprozesse. Führen, coachen und entwickeln Sie eine leistungsstarke Planungs- und Fulfillment-Organisation, einschließlich Planungs-, Materialmanagement-, operativen Einkaufs-, Fulfillment- und Logistikexperten. Ihr Hintergrundstudium in Engineering, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management oder einem verwandten Bereich. Master-Abschluss (MBA oder Supply Chain Spezialisierung) bevorzugt. Mindestens 8-10 Jahre fortschrittliche Erfahrung in den Bereichen Supply Chain, Planung, Fulfillment, Produktionsplanung, Logistik oder Operations Management. Mindestens 5 Jahre Führungserfahrung im Bereich Sales Engineering & Operations Planning (vorzugsweise in einem ETO-Geschäft). Kenntnisse in ERP-Systemen und Supply Chain Management Software; Kenntnisse in Advanced Planning Tools (wie Drummer oder Cyberplan sind ein Plus). Hervorragende analytische und problemlösende Fähigkeiten, mit einem datengesteuerten Ansatz zur Entscheidungsfindung (Lean Manufacturing oder Six Sigma-Zertifizierung ist ein Plus). Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Informationen effektiv zu vermitteln. Italienisch ist obligatorisch; fließend in englisch. Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, Teams zu führen und zu betreuen, um eine Kultur der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung und des Lernens zu fördern. En connectant la stratégie aux opérations, vous dirigerez les processus de planification, favoriserez la collaboration dans toute la chaîne de valeur et assurerez un équilibre optimal entre le service, l'inventaire, la capacité et les coûts. Votre expertise contribuera à renforcer la résilience opérationnelle, à accélérer les initiatives de transformation et à soutenir la réalisation de nos engagements commerciaux et clients. Comment vous allez avoir un impact Propre et diriger les processus de planification de l'usine, à partir de la planification à long terme de la demande, de l'ingénierie des ventes et de la planification des opérations (SE&OP), de la planification des capacités, de la planification de la production principale, du calendrier détaillé, de la planification des matériaux et des processus d'exécution des ventes et des opérations (S&OE). Diriger le processus local de SE&OP et s'aligner sur l'équipe de planification de la gamme de produits, évaluer la capacité de l'usine à appuyer le plan de demande à long terme et assurer l'alignement entre les besoins des clients, la capacité de production, la disponibilité du matériel, la stratégie d'inventaire et les objectifs financiers. Traduire les prévisions de la demande, les commandes des clients et les exigences du projet en plans d'approvisionnement, de production, de matériel et de livraison réalisables et surveiller constamment l'exactitude des prévisions et le développement de l'arriéré. Gérer la production à court, moyen et long terme et coordonner les priorités et la capacité de production et d'approvisionnement, optimiser l'utilisation des capacités installées et habitées tout en maintenant la flexibilité opérationnelle et la fiabilité de la livraison des clients. Établir, surveiller et améliorer en permanence les principaux indicateurs de rendement de la planification et de l'exécution (livraison en temps voulu du client, respect du calendrier (OTD interne), délai de livraison total grâce au TPT, précision des prévisions, disponibilité du matériel, utilisation de la capacité, tours d'inventaire, performance de livraison du fournisseur) afin d'offrir une visibilité en temps réel des performances de l'usine. Dirigez le déploiement, l'adoption et l'optimisation des solutions ERP (SAP 4\/Hana), de planification avancée et de calendrier, d'analyse et de chaîne d'approvisionnement numérique. Diriger les initiatives d'amélioration continue et d'excellence opérationnelle dans les processus de planification, d'approvisionnement, d'inventaire, de réalisation et de logistique. Diriger, coacher et développer une organisation de planification et d'exécution hautement performante, y compris la planification, la gestion du matériel, les achats opérationnels, l'exécution et les professionnels de la logistique. Votre formation Diplôme en génie, administration des affaires, gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, gestion des opérations ou un domaine connexe. Maîtrise (MBA ou spécialisation en chaîne d'approvisionnement) préférée. Au moins 8 à 10 ans d'expérience progressive dans la chaîne d'approvisionnement, la planification, l'exécution, la planification de la production, la logistique ou la gestion des opérations. Minimum de 5 ans d'expérience en leadership dans la planification de l'ingénierie des ventes et des opérations (de préférence dans une entreprise ETO). Connaissance des systèmes ERP et des logiciels de gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement; connaissance des outils de planification avancés (comme Drummer ou Cyberplan est un plus). Excellente capacité d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes, avec une approche de la prise de décision fondée sur les données (La fabrication Lean ou la certification Six Sigma est un plus). De solides compétences en communication avec la capacité de transmettre efficacement l'information. L'italien est obligatoire; Fluent en anglais. Capacité démontrée de diriger et de guider des équipes, favorisant une culture d'amélioration continue et d'apprentissage. L'expérience dans les transformateurs ou l'équipement électrique est plus mais pas obligatoire. En savoir plus sur nous : Hitachi Energy se consacre à favoriser un milieu de travail inclusif où chaque membre de l'équipe peut prospérer et apporter ses perspectives et compétences uniques.
• Nous offrons des salaires concurrentiels, des horaires de travail flexibles, des possibilités de perfectionnement professionnel et un milieu de travail favorable qui favorise la croissance et l'innovation grâce au programme de perfectionnement professionnel.

jobs.description:
Über die Position Als Maintenance Operator bist du Teil des eMobility-Bereichs und arbeitest in verschiedenen Produktionsbereichen wie Reinraum, Testing und Grauraum. Du übernimmst 
• Aufgaben im Bereich Maintenance und unterstützt gleichzeitig den Produktionsbetrieb durch die Bedienung und Überwachung vollautomatisierter Produktionsanlagen. Durch deine Flexibilität innerhalb der erlernten Areas sowie deine lösungsorientierte und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise trägst du zu einem sicheren, effizienten und qualitativ hochwertigen Produktionsablauf bei.     Das kannst du bewirken Bearbeitung von Produktionslosen gemäss den gültigen Arbeitsanweisungen unter Reinraumbedingungen in den Bereichen eMobility, Reinraum, Testing und Grauraum Einrichten, Bedienen und Überwachen der vollautomatisierten Produktionsanlagen sowie Bedienung der anwendbaren Leitsysteme wie MES, SAP und BO Report Flexible Job Rotation zwischen den erlernten Areas und Tätigkeiten sowie Bereitschaft, weitere Arbeitsbereiche zu erlernen Umsetzung von Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) an komplexen Anlagen in der mechanischen Fertigung und im Testing gemäss Arbeitsanweisungen sowie Durchführung täglicher Maschinenkontrollen inklusive SPC Überwachung und Sicherstellung der Bevorratung von Produktionsmedien sowie Pflege der Verbrauchsmaterialien für die Produktionsmaschinen Organisation und Durchführung von Reinigungsarbeiten an Arbeitsplätzen, Reinraum-Infrastruktur, Anlagen, Materialien und Modulen gemäss den gültigen Arbeitsanweisungen Mitarbeit bei der Sicherstellung von Qualität, Ordnung und Sicherheit sowie im kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprozess; zusätzlich punktuelle Unterstützung der Instandhaltungstechniker und -ingenieure Unterstützung bei der Ausbildung neuer Maintenance Operatoren sowie Übernahme zusätzlicher 
• Aufgaben gemäss Anweisung der Schichtleitung       Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene Berufsbildung EFZ oder EBA in einem technischen Berufsfeld Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens Niveau C1 Lösungsorientierte Herangehensweise sowie gute Problemlösungsfähigkeit und die Fähigkeit, bei Prozessschwierigkeiten strukturiert und auch unter Stress sowie unter Einhaltung von Fristen zu arbeiten Hands-on-Mentalität sowie gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit und soziale Kompetenz mit der Fähigkeit, auf verschiedenen Hierarchie- und Kompetenzstufen effektiv zu kommunizieren Grundkenntnisse in Standardsoftware wie MS Office; SAP-Kenntnisse von Vorteil Offenheit für ein 2-Schichtsystem sowie Bereitschaft zur kontinuierlichen persönlichen Weiterentwicklung und Teilnahme an Schulungen       Mehr über uns Hitachi Energy gestaltet die Energiezukunft mit innovativen Technologien für eine nachhaltige und zuverlässige Energieversorgung. Bei uns erwartet dich ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld, ein starkes Team und die Möglichkeit, dich fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln.   Hinweis zum Umgang mit sensitiven Informationen: Ein Qualitätstechniker hat Einsicht in sensitive Informationen!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Come operatore di manutenzione, fai parte dell'area eMobility e lavori in varie aree di produzione come camera pulita, test e stanza grigia. Prendi il tuo posto
• Le attività di manutenzione e allo stesso tempo supportano le operazioni di produzione operando e monitorando impianti di produzione completamente automatizzati. Con la vostra flessibilità nelle aree apprese e il vostro metodo di lavoro orientato alla soluzione e attento, contribuite ad un processo di produzione sicuro, efficiente e di alta qualità. E' possibile raggiungere questo obiettivo elaborando lotti di produzione in base alle valide istruzioni di lavoro in condizioni di ambiente pulito nelle aree di eMobility, clean room, testing e grey room. Supporto aggiuntivo per tecnici di manutenzione e ingegneri Supporto per la formazione di nuovi operatori di manutenzione e supporto aggiuntivo
• Compiti secondo l'istruzione della gestione dei turni Questo ti porta a una formazione professionale completa EFZ o EBA in un campo tecnico professionale competenze tedesche almeno livello C1 approccio orientato alla soluzione, così come una buona capacità di problem solving e la capacità di lavorare in caso di difficoltà di processo strutturate e anche sotto stress, così come nel rispetto delle scadenze mani-on benefici mentali, così come buone capacità di comunicazione e competenze sociali con la capacità di comunicare efficacemente a diversi livelli gerarchici e competenze conoscenze base nel software standard come MS Office Con noi, ci si può aspettare un ambiente di lavoro moderno, un team forte e l'opportunità di sviluppare professionalmente e personalmente. descriptionByLocale.en:
As a maintenance operator, you are part of the eMobility area and work in various production areas such as clean room, testing and grey room. You take over
• Maintenance tasks and at the same time supports production operations by operating and monitoring fully automated production facilities. With your flexibility within the learned areas as well as your solution-oriented and careful working method, you contribute to a safe, efficient and high-quality production process. You can achieve this by processing production lots according to the valid work instructions under clean room conditions in the areas of eMobility, clean room, testing and grey room Setting up, operation and monitoring of the fully automated production plants as well as operation of the applicable control systems such as MES, SAP and BO Report Flexible Job Rotation between the learned areas and activities as well as readiness to learn further work areas Implementation of Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) on complex plants in mechanical production and testing according to work instructions as well as carrying out daily machine controls including SPC monitoring and ensuring the storage of production media as well as maintenance of the consumables for the production machines Organization and implementation of cleaning work at workplaces, clean room infrastructure, plants, materials and modules according to the valid work instructions Cooperation in ensuring quality, order and safety as well as in the continuous improvement process; Additional support for maintenance technicians and engineers Support in the training of new maintenance operators as well as additional support
• Tasks according to the instruction of shift management This brings you with completed vocational training EFZ or EBA in a technical professional field German skills at least level C1 solution-oriented approach as well as good problem-solving ability and the ability to work in case of process difficulties structured and also under stress as well as in compliance with deadlines hands-on mentality as well as good communication skills and social competence with the ability to communicate effectively at different hierarchical and competence levels basic knowledge in standard software such as MS Office; SAP knowledge benefits Openness for a 2-layer system as well as readiness for continuous personal development and participation in training More about us Hitachi Energy shapes the energy future with innovative technologies for a sustainable and reliable energy supply. With us, you can expect a modern working environment, a strong team and the opportunity to develop professionally and personally. Note on handling sensitive information: A quality technician has insight into sensitive information!

jobs.title: Territory Sales Manager 80 – 100%
jobs.description: The opportunity  Join our team as a Territory Sales Manager and drive the growth of our High Voltage Bushings and On-Load Tap-Changers business across the Brazilian market. Leveraging your strong network and market knowledge, you will help expand our presence with transformer manufacturers, utilities, EPC companies, and industrial customers while representing products manufactured in our Swiss and Swedish factories. This role offers the opportunity to combine your technical understanding of the power industry with your commercial expertise in one of the world's most dynamic energy markets. Working closely with customers and internal experts, you will contribute to strategic business development initiatives, identify new opportunities, and build long-term customer partnerships that support the energy transition. The role is based in Altstetten, Zurich, Switzerland, and involves approximately 20–30% travel. How you'll make an impact   Develop and grow business opportunities for High Voltage Bushings and On-Load Tap-Changers across the Brazilian market Build and strengthen relationships with transformer manufacturers, utilities, EPC contractors, and industrial customers Identify market trends, customer needs, and emerging opportunities to support long-term business growth Lead commercial discussions and support negotiations with key customers and stakeholders Collaborate with Offer Engineering and Tendering teams to develop competitive technical and commercial solutions Prepare and review proposals based on customer requirements and market expectations Maintain an accurate sales pipeline and contribute to forecasting activities Ensure smooth handover of secured orders to project management and execution teams Your background  Minimum 10 years of experience in sales, business development, engineering, or a similar customer-facing role within the energy, electrical, transformer, or industrial sector Strong knowledge of the Brazilian power and energy market, including utilities, transformer manufacturers, and key industry stakeholders Proven track record of developing customer relationships and driving business growth in Brazil Technical background in electrical or mechanical engineering or equivalent industry experience Experience working in international and multicultural business environments Strong communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills Business fluent in English and Portuguese, Spanish is an asset Self-driven, relationship-oriented, and able to work independently while collaborating effectively with global teams More about us    Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

L'opportunité Joignez-vous à notre équipe en tant que responsable des ventes de territoire et dirigez la croissance de nos activités de Bushings haute tension et de changeurs de robinets sur le marché brésilien. Grâce à votre solide connaissance du réseau et du marché, vous contribuerez à élargir notre présence auprès des fabricants de transformation, des services publics, des entreprises EPC et des clients industriels tout en représentant les produits fabriqués dans nos usines suisses et suédoises.

jobs.title: Internship in Mechanical and System Simulations for High Voltage Circuit Breakers 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity Join an innovative and collaborative engineering team shaping the future of high-voltage technology. You will contribute to the development of next-generation SF6-free circuit breakers in a supportive and knowledge-sharing environment. This role offers hands-on experience with simulations, measurements, and cutting-edge engineering tools. You will learn from experienced mentors while taking ownership of meaningful tasks. The position supports continuous learning, curiosity, and professional growth. Duration of the internship is 9-12 months.   How you'll make an impact Support development of SF6-free high-voltage circuit breakers through simulations Perform system simulations of circuit breakers to support design decisions P re and post processing of simulations models and results Test data analysis and preparation of the simulation input files Use and further develop internally established simulation tools Collaborating with interdisciplinary project teams in circuit breaker development   Your background Enrolled Student (preferably Master) or Graduate in Physics, Mechanical, Electrical Engineering, or a related field Basic knowledge of simulations associated with mechanical and electrical engineering applications Knowledge of mechanics and material strength (practical skills in ABAQUS or similar finite element code is advantageous) Knowledge and practical skills of Modelica language and Dymola are advantageous Strong programming skills and interest in Python Fluency in written and spoken English Ability to work collaboratively and take initiative independently   More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'occasione Unisciti a un team di ingegneria innovativo e collaborativo che modella il futuro della tecnologia ad alta tensione. Contribuirai allo sviluppo di interruttori SF6 di nuova generazione in un ambiente di supporto e condivisione delle conoscenze. Questo ruolo offre esperienza pratica con simulazioni, misurazioni e strumenti di ingegneria all'avanguardia. Imparerai da mentori esperti durante l'assunzione di compiti significativi. La posizione supporta l'apprendimento continuo, la curiosità e la crescita professionale. La durata dello stage è di 9-12 mesi. Sviluppo del supporto di interruttori a alta tensione senza SF6 attraverso simulazioni Eseguire simulazioni di sistema di interruttori di circuiti per supportare le decisioni di progettazione P re e post elaborazione di modelli e risultati di simulazioni Analisi dei dati di prova e preparazione dei file di input di simulazione Utilizzare e sviluppare ulteriormente strumenti di simulazione internamente consolidati Collaborando con team di progetto interdisciplinari nello sviluppo dell'interruttore Il tuo background Studente iscritto (preferibilmente Master) o Laureato in Fisica, Meccanica, Ingegneria Elettrica, o un campo correlato Conoscenze di base delle simulazioni associate a applicazioni di ingegneria meccanica ed elettrica Conoscenza della meccanica e della resistenza dei materiali (competenze pratiche in ABAQUS o simili codice degli elementi finiti) Conoscenza e competenze pratiche del linguaggio Modelica e Dymola sono vantaggiose Forte capacità di programmazione e interesse per Python Fluency in inglese scritto e parlato Capacità di lavorare in collaborazione e prendere iniziativa in modo indipendente Più su di noi Siamo una società tecnologica-driven con una forte attenzione all'innovazione, al miglioramento continuo e alla produzione sostenibile.

jobs.title: Global Manufacturing Process Definition & Improvement Specialist Professional
jobs.description: The Opportunity At Hitachi Energy, our purpose is advancing a sustainable energy future for all. We bring power to our homes, schools, hospitals, and factories. Join us and work with fantastic people, while learning and developing yourself on projects that have a real impact to our communities and society. Bring your passion, bring your energy, and be part of a global team that appreciates a simple truth: Diversity + Collaboration = Great Innovation. As a Global Casting Process Definition & Improvement Specialist Professional at HITACHI ENERGY LTD, you will be responsible for defining, optimizing, and improving Casting processes and equipment across our global operations. This role focuses on driving efficiency, standardizing best practices, and implementing innovative solutions to enhance productivity and product quality. How you'll make an impact: Lead the development and documentation of standardized casting processes and equipment, work instructions, and best practices across various production sites globally. Analyze existing casting processes to identify bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and areas for improvement using lean manufacturing and Six Sigma methodologies. Design and implement process and equipment improvements, including new technologies, automation solutions, and operational workflows, to optimize production output, reduce costs, and enhance quality. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including R&D, engineering, quality, and production, to ensure seamless integration of new processes, equipment and technologies.Develop and deliver training programs for manufacturing personnel on new and improved processes and tools. Monitor and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) related to casting processes, identifying trends and recommending corrective actions.Conduct process audits and assessments to ensure compliance with defined standards and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. Support the implementation of digital manufacturing initiatives and Industry 4.0 technologies.Stay abreast of industry best practices, new technologies, and regulatory requirements related to casting processes. Manage complex projects related to process and equipment improvement, ensuring timely completion and adherence to budget. Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external & internal regulations, procedures & guidelines. Your Background Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or Manufacturing preferred) or a related technical field. Master's degree is a plus. Strong years of experience in casting process engineering, process improvement, or a similar role within a global manufacturing environment. Proven track record of successfully implementing process improvements and driving operational excellence&Strong knowledge of lean manufacturing principles, Six Sigma methodologies (Green Belt or Black Belt certification preferred), and other continuous improvement tools. Experience with manufacturing execution systems (MES), enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, and other relevant manufacturing software.Proficiency in process mapping, value stream mapping, and other process analysis techniques. Excellent project management, analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to lead complex initiatives and effectively influence stakeholders at all organizational levels. Ability to travel internationally as required to various manufacturing sites. Fluency in English is required; proficiency in other languages is a plus. More about us We pride ourselves on offering a holistic range of competitive benefits to support your financial, physical, and mental wellbeing, as well as your professional growth. We want you to truly thrive with us, in work and out.

Collaborating with experts across multiple locations, you will drive the evolution of design automation solutions, support users worldwide, and contribute to engineering excellence through standardization, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing. jobs.title: R&D Design Engineer - Insulation and Components Global Product Care
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is seeking a Design Engineer for the Business Unit Transformers to join our innovative and forward-thinking Global Product Care team for Insulation and Components. You will play a crucial role in the development and design of innovative products and systems that meet our customer needs and industry standards. You will collaborate with cross functional teams and factories globally to ensure project specifications are met while adhering to industry standards and design best practices. Your expertise in engineering principles and practices will contribute to optimize designs for performance, functionality, and sustainability. How you will make an impact You will establish mechanical simulation models for transformer components such as bushings, tap-changers and measurement devices, conduct static\/dynamic mechanics, model, seismic, short-circuit impact and thermal-structure coupling simulation analysis. You will conduct mechanical performance verification in accordance with IEC, IEEE, GB and other international & domestic standards, issue professional simulation reports, provide technical support for product R&D, type test and mass production. You will continue to develop internal tools for mechanical evaluations, participate in industrial technical exchanges. Support factories troubleshooting in your domain of expertise and collaborate with global team on evaluation of new R&D solution. You will be responsible for ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Collaborate with the supply chain team to ensure designs are manufacturable and cost-effective, selecting optimal materials and components. Evaluate and select appropriate materials and manufacturing processes. Conduct thorough design reviews and verifications, implementing modifications to elevate project quality. Take on project leadership responsibilities or play a key role within project teams, while supporting and mentoring junior colleagues Act as a subject matter expert, supporting colleagues and sharing knowledge to foster collaboration and innovation within the team Your background Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Physics, or a related field Minimum 3 years of experience in R&D or engineering, preferably in high voltage equipment or components Solid mechanical knowledge, ideally in the field of electrical insulators or high-voltage components Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken Should have good understanding of IEC \/IEEE\/ISO\/ASTM Standards. Experience in the finite element analysis and in the use of the ANSYS software Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to speak with and work together with the technical teams in different parts of the world. Proactive attitude, self-motivated and with a strong sense of ownership. Open to change, feedback and continuous improvement. More about us    At Hitachi Energy, we recognize that our people are at the heart of our success. descriptionByLocale.en: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is seeking a Design Engineer for the Business Unit Transformers to join our innovative and forward-thinking Global Product Care team for Insulation and Components. You will play a crucial role in the development and design of innovative products and systems that meet our customer needs and industry standards. You will collaborate with cross functional teams and factories globally to ensure project specifications are met while adhering to industry standards and design best practices. Your expertise in engineering principles and practices will contribute to optimize designs for performance, functionality, and sustainability. You will conduct mechanical performance verification in accordance with IEC, IEEE, GB and other international & domestic standards, issue professional simulation reports, provide technical support for product R&D, type test and mass production. You will continue to develop internal tools for mechanical evaluations, participate in industrial technical exchanges. Support factories troubleshooting in your domain of expertise and collaborate with global team on evaluation of new R&D solution. You will be responsible for ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Collaborate with the supply chain team to ensure designs are manufacturable and cost-effective, selecting optimal materials and components. Evaluate and select appropriate materials and manufacturing processes. Conduct thorough design reviews and verifications, implementing modifications to elevate project quality. Take on project leadership responsibilities or play a key role within project teams, while supporting and mentoring junior colleagues Act as a subject matter expert, supporting colleagues and sharing knowledge to foster collaboration and innovation within the team Your background Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Physics, or a related field Minimum 3 years of experience in R&D or engineering, preferably in high voltage equipment or components Solid mechanical knowledge, ideally in the field of electrical insulators or high-voltage components Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken Should have good understanding of IEC \/IEEE\/ISO\/ASTM Standards. Experience in the finite element analysis and in the use of the ANSYS software Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to speak with and work together with the technical teams in different parts of the world. Proactive attitude, self-motivated and with a strong sense of ownership. Open to change, feedback and continuous improvement. More about us At Hitachi Energy, we recognize that our people are at the heart of our success. descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Hitachi Energy cherche un ingénieur de conception pour les transformateurs d'unité d'affaires pour rejoindre notre équipe innovante et prospective Global Product Care pour l'isolation et les composants. Capacité de parler et de travailler avec les équipes techniques dans différentes parties du monde. attitude proactive, automotivée et avec un fort sentiment d'appropriation. jobs.title: Senior Quality Engineer 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity     Hitachi Energy is a global leader in power and renewable technologies that enable utility and industry customers to improve their performance while lowering environmental impact. CHSEM provides high‑power semiconductor devices to Hitachi Energy internal customers (e.g. HVDC, GPQSS) as well as to external customers. The Senior Material Quality Engineer ensures the quality, robustness, and long‑term reliability of critical raw materials used in BiMOS semiconductor device production at the Lenzburg fabrication facility. Acting as a technical authority, the role independently manages complex material‑ and supplier‑related quality topics, contributes to supplier quality strategy, and supports both supplier and team capability development to enable stable and scalable operations. H ow you'll make an impact   Drive the material quality approach for critical raw materials used in BiMOS operations Define and continuously improve CTQ concepts and control strategies Lead complex material quality investigations related to deviations, yield, and reliability issues Monitor & develop supplier performance and ensure effective implementation of corrective actions Lead material qualification, requalification, and change management activities Support production with technical expertise during production, troubleshooting, and ramp-up phases Drive cross-functional improvement initiatives to enhance quality, reliability, and cost efficiency Act as a technical reference, supporting or mentoring engineers and strengthening supplier and team capabilities   Your background   Bachelor's or Master's degree in Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics, or a related field Minimum 5 years of experience in material quality, supplier quality, or semiconductor manufacturing Certified auditor (VDA 6.3, ISO 19011, or equivalent) Strong knowledge of material quality, process control, and risk management in a manufacturing environment Proven ability to independently manage complex material and supplier quality issues Experience with structured quality methods such as 8D, Six Sigma, or equivalent More about us

jobs.title: Scientist in AI-Driven Power Electronics (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Empower the Future with Hitachi Energy: Join us as Scientist in AI-Driven Power Electronics We are looking for a research scientist with expertise in power electronics and power grid applications to join our Research Center in Baden\/Switzerland. In an interdisciplinary environment, you will drive cutting-edge innovation and develop new solutions for a wide range of fast-growing applications like HVDC, energy storage systems and renewables like wind or solar. Seize this unique opportunity and join our motivated team to contribute to a sustainable energy future for all!  How you'll make an impact   You innovate: Transform power electronics modeling, design and optimization by incorporating AI and ML You investigate: Perform industrial research in multi-physics modelling and optimization for power electronic systems to create advanced, high-efficiency engineering tools targeting new solutions for power grid applications. You take initiative: Collaborate with a global and interdisciplinary team of researchers and engineers across research and business units to identify, shape, and solve impactful industrial challenges You collaborate: Build relationships within the company and actively share your knowledge and expertise. Interact with local and global external partners including universities and vendors You communicate: Disseminate your results in scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports    Your background  PhD in Electrical Engineering specialized in Power Electronics or PhD in Computer Science specialized in AI Proven expertise in AI\/ML, with a solid understanding of algorithms, frameworks, and extensive experience in Python and relevant software tools Ability to apply AI\/ML to engineering problems, in particular in the field of power electronics Experience in power electronics design and modeling. Know-how in power electronics integration topics such as cooling and mechanical integration, insulation, EMC, and grid integration is considered as a plus Excellent communication skills in English, team player attitude, initiative and creativity More about us   At Hitachi Energy, we believe in the power of diversity and the potential of every person. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We invite you to apply and join us in shaping a sustainable future.

jobs.title: Tender and Quotation Specialist 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Our local product group Insulation & Components is a global technology leader in the design and manufacture of high-voltage transformer bushings. Renowned international companies across the electrical industry—including power generation, transmission, and distribution—trust our solutions. We hold a leading worldwide position in high-voltage bushing technology. To strengthen our operations, we are looking for a Tender and Quotation Specialist (commercial) to join our team at our MICAFIL bushing factory in Switzerland.  In this role, you will be part of an international team focusing on translating customer needs and challenges into competitive bids and quotations. You'll work closely with our sales and other internal teams to ensure that we offer the best solutions to meet our customers' needs around the globe. If you are passionate about preparing tenders and bids and want to actively contribute, join our team! How you'll make an impact Analyze Request for Quotations (RFQs), and other tender documents to understand client requirements, scope of work, and technical specifications with alignment with the Sales team Collaborate with sales, engineering, legal, and other internal departments to gather necessary information, technical details, and cost estimates for tender submissions Develop comprehensive and well-structured tender and quotation documents, including technical proposals, drawings, commercial offers and supporting documentation Ensure all submissions are accurate, complete, and meet the specified deadlines and submission protocols May participate in pre-bid meetings, client clarifications, and negotiations as required Maintain a systematic record of all tender activities, submissions, and outcomes, for quotations and order checklists preparation and handover Continuously improve tender processes and documentation templates to enhance efficiency and quality Coordinate with internal stakeholders for optimal solutions. Proactively maintain clear and structured communication with customers and the internal teams throughout the tendering process Your background Technical (vocational, such as apprenticeship) or commercial education background Minimum of 3 years of administrative\/business experience in tendering activities, quotation preparation and price calculation, or bid coordination, internal sales support, or project management within an industrial or technical environment Proven experience in formulating accurate bids and quotations Strong understanding of tender processes, contractual terms, and commercial aspects Excellent written and verbal communication skills Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and experience with tender management software or CRM systems Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to details and solution-driven approach Fluency in English is required; proficiency in German and other languages is a plus More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Il nostro gruppo di prodotti locale Insulation & Components è un leader tecnologico globale nella progettazione e produzione di boccole per trasformatori ad alta tensione. Rinomate aziende internazionali nel settore elettrico, tra cui la generazione di energia, la trasmissione e la distribuzione, si affidano alle nostre soluzioni. Abbiamo una posizione leader a livello mondiale nella tecnologia di boccole ad alta tensione. Per rafforzare le nostre operazioni, stiamo cercando uno specialista Tender e Quotation (commerciale) per unirsi al nostro team nella nostra fabbrica di boccole MICAFIL in Svizzera. In questo ruolo, sarete parte di un team internazionale che si concentra sulla traduzione delle esigenze e delle sfide dei clienti in offerte e citazioni competitive. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con le nostre vendite e altri team interni per garantire che offriamo le migliori soluzioni per soddisfare le esigenze dei nostri clienti in tutto il mondo. Se siete appassionati di preparare offerte e offerte e volete contribuire attivamente, unisciti al nostro team! Analizzare la richiesta di quotazioni (RFQ) e altri documenti d'appalto per comprendere i requisiti del cliente, l'ambito di lavoro e le specifiche tecniche con allineamento con il team di vendita Collaborare con le attività di vendita, ingegneria, legale e altri dipartimenti interni per raccogliere informazioni necessarie, dettagli tecnici e stime dei costi per le presentazioni di gara Sviluppare documenti di gara e di quotazione completi e ben strutturati, tra cui proposte tecniche, disegni, offerte commerciali e documentazione di supporto Proattivamente mantenere la comunicazione chiara e strutturata con i clienti e le squadre interne durante il processo di aggiudicazione Il vostro background tecnico (professionale, come l'apprendistato) o lo sfondo dell'istruzione commerciale Minimo di 3 anni di esperienza amministrativa\/commerciale nelle attività di aggiudicazione, preparazione delle quote e calcolo dei prezzi, o coordinamento delle offerte, supporto delle vendite interne, o gestione del progetto all'interno di un ambiente industriale o eccellente

Des entreprises internationales renommées dans l'industrie électrique – y compris la production, le transport et la distribution d'électricité – font confiance à nos solutions. Nous détenons une position de leader mondial dans la technologie de douille haute tension. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec nos ventes et d'autres équipes internes pour vous assurer que nous offrons les meilleures solutions pour répondre aux besoins de nos clients partout dans le monde. Si vous êtes passionné par la préparation des appels d'offres et que vous voulez contribuer activement, rejoignez notre équipe ! Maintenir de façon proactive une communication claire et structurée avec les clients et les équipes internes tout au long du processus d'appel d'offres Vos antécédents Technique (professionnel, comme l'apprentissage) ou formation commerciale Expérience minimale de 3 ans d'expérience administrative/d'affaires dans les activités d'appel d'offres, la préparation des devis et le calcul des prix, ou la coordination des soumissions, le soutien interne aux ventes ou la gestion de projet dans un environnement industriel ou technique Expérience éprouvée dans la formulation d'offres et de devis précis Une bonne compréhension des processus d'appel d'offres, des termes contractuels et des aspects commerciaux Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale Compétence en Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) et expérience avec les logiciels de gestion des soumissions ou les systèmes CRM Fortes compétences en analyse et en résolution de problèmes, avec une attention particulière aux détails et à l'approche axée sur la solution La maîtrise de l'anglais est un atout.

jobs.title: Photolithography Process Engineer 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Join a high performing photolithography team where your expertise truly makes an impact. As a Senior Photolithography Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and optimizing photolithography processes used in semiconductor manufacturing. Your role will involve working with advanced lithography equipment, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and ensuring high-quality production standards. This is your opportunity to shape technical decisions, contribute to long term tool strategies, and drive meaningful improvements in stability, uptime, and process performance. Are you someone who takes ownership, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and enjoys making a real impact? Then apply today! How you'll make an impact Ensure processes meet the production program and yield goals and address any product yield and rework issues. Engage with equipment and material vendors to develop new solutions and improve existing processes, to ensure smooth functioning of the production line. Develop new techniques, modify existing designs, and coordinate process improvement projects. Analyze process data to identify trends, optimize performance, and troubleshoot issues (implement and regularly check SPC). Independent planning and Implementation of new machinery into the production line. Work closely with process integration, wet etch, diffusion, metals, dry etch, and implant teams to ensure seamless production. Supports some metrology tools i.e. to measure CD and Overlay. On-call duties on weekends and public holidays (as required from the production) with participation in the on-call meeting (before the on-call duty) agreed on his own responsibility with the other on-call service providers. Your background Bachelor's degree in a related field (e.g., Electrical, Mechanical, Chemical, Materials Science or Physics) with 5+ years of experience in industry or master's degree with 3+ years of experience in industry or Ph.D. with industry experience Extensive experience in wafer photolithography operations especially in coating and exposure in Steppers, in a wafer manufacturing environment (thin-film-head, semiconductor wafer manufacturing) Familiarity with automated wafer factory software systems like SPC, MES and Experience with data extraction, manipulation, and analysis Strong understanding of optics and immersion lithography Proficiency in data science and programming is preferred Good English and German language skills Ability to work in a cleanroom environment More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: Unisciti a un team di fotolitografia ad alte prestazioni in cui la tua esperienza fa davvero un impatto. In qualità di Senior Photolithography Engineer, sarai responsabile dello sviluppo e dell'ottimizzazione dei processi fotolitici utilizzati nella produzione di semiconduttori. Il vostro ruolo sarà quello di lavorare con apparecchiature di litografia avanzate, collaborando con team interfunzionali e garantendo standard di produzione di alta qualità. Questa è la vostra opportunità per modellare le decisioni tecniche, contribuire a strategie di utensili a lungo termine, e guidare miglioramenti significativi nella stabilità, uptime e le prestazioni di processo. Sei qualcuno che prende la proprietà, prospera in un ambiente frenetico e gode di un impatto reale? Allora applica oggi! Come farete un impatto Assicuratevi che i processi soddisfino il programma di produzione e gli obiettivi di resa e affrontino eventuali problemi di resa e rielaborazione dei prodotti. Impegnarsi con attrezzature e fornitori di materiali per sviluppare nuove soluzioni e migliorare i processi esistenti, per garantire un buon funzionamento della linea di produzione. Sviluppare nuove tecniche, modificare i progetti esistenti e coordinare i progetti di miglioramento del processo. Analizzare i dati di processo per identificare le tendenze, ottimizzare le prestazioni e risolvere i problemi (implementazione e controllare regolarmente SPC). Progettazione indipendente e realizzazione di nuovi macchinari nella linea di produzione. Lavorare a stretto contatto con l'integrazione dei processi, l'incisione bagnata, la diffusione, i metalli, l'incisione secca e i team di impianti per garantire la produzione senza soluzione di continuità. Supporta alcuni strumenti di metrologia per misurare CD e Overlay. I dazi doganali nei fine settimana e nei giorni festivi (come richiesto dalla produzione) con la partecipazione alla riunione on-call (prima dell'obbligo di pagamento) hanno concordato sulla propria responsabilità con gli altri fornitori di servizi on-call. La tua laurea di primo livello in un campo relativo (ad esempio, elettrico, meccanico, chimico, scienza dei materiali o fisica) con 5+ anni di esperienza nell'industria o master con 3+ anni di esperienza nell'industria o nel Ph.D. con esperienza nell'industria Estensiva esperienza nelle operazioni di fotolitografia wafer soprattutto nel rivestimento e nell'esposizione in Steppers, in un ambiente di produzione wafer (testa di film, wafer semiconduttore) Familiarità con sistemi software di fabbrica di wafer automatizzati come SPC, MES e Experience con l'estrazione dei dati, la manipolazione e l'analisi Forte comprensione dell'ottica e della litografia di immersione La competenza nella scienza e nella programmazione dei dati è preferita Buon Inglese e Tedesco competenze linguistiche Capacità di lavorare in un ambiente pulito Più su di noi Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali, creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.
